archetype: LUK thief whose kit splits into three named families. Arts skills are the direct chakram attacks, and the pre-5th-job Arts skills reduce the cooldowns of Void Rush and Void Blitz. Void skills are mostly utility: Void Rush and Void Blitz put the character into Dark Sight, Void Burst grants invincibility, and from 3rd job Void skills can spawn Chakri. Hex skills are the cooldown-gated wide or special attacks, and from 3rd job they consume the Chakri to throw projectiles called Resonate. Source for the family behaviour: Grandis Library's mechanics block.

linkSkill.name: Innate Gift
linkSkill.effect: Passive damage increase plus an on-attack HP/MP regeneration window. At level 1: Damage +3%, and on attacking a 100% chance to recover 1% of Max HP/MP per second for 5 seconds, 30 second cooldown. At level 3: Damage +7% and 3% of Max HP/MP per second. The skill is explicitly not affected by cooldown resets, cooldown reduction, or buff duration increase.
linkSkill.levels: Master Level 3. The level 1 and level 3 figures above are as listed on MapleStory Wiki; Grandis Library quotes the same maxed figures.

legionEffect: Flat LUK: +10 / +20 / +40 / +80 / +100 across Legion ranks B through SSS.

hexa.notes: NO HEXA INVESTMENT ORDER COULD BE SOURCED, and none is invented here. What exists and what blocks it: (1) Grandis Library hosts a Khali '6th Job' infographic at https://www.grandislibrary.com/class-infographic/khali/khali-6th-job.png, credited in the page data to the Khali Discord and dated 2026-06-25 - the most current Khali HEXA artefact found anywhere. It is a grid of roughly 165 in-game HEXA core icons each stamped with a target level, with no text labels at all. The icons are in-game HEXA core art rather than the named skill icons Grandis serves elsewhere, so they could not be matched to skill names by pixel comparison and were deliberately not transcribed. It needs a human or a vision/OCR pass. (2) MapleDoro carries a second image-only variant at /infographics/khali-hexa-heroic.webp under a HEXA Guide heading with a Heroic label and no accompanying text; the rest of that page is empty. (3) MapleGains, a GMS-data HEXA optimizer, supports only Battle Mage, Buccaneer, Cannon Master, Corsair, Mercedes and Mihile - Khali is not in its class list. (4) Khali has no public class Google Doc; Grandis Library's Other Resources block for Khali links only MapleStory Wiki, NamuWiki and the class Discord. SOURCED HEXA FACTS, which are structure rather than priority: Skill Node/Core 1 (Origin) is Hex: Sandstorm and Skill Node/Core 2 (Ascent) is Wake the Void. Hex: Sandstorm's level breakpoints are Lv10 Ignore Defense +20%, Lv20 Boss Damage +20%, Lv30 Ignore Defense +30% and Boss Damage +30%. Wake the Void's are Lv10 Ignore Defense +10% and Boss Damage +10%, Lv20 a further Ignore Defense +10% and Boss Damage +10%, Lv30 Ignore Defense +20%. The ten Mastery cores are HEXA Arts: Flurry, HEXA Arts: Crescentum, HEXA Void Rush, HEXA Void Blitz, HEXA Hex: Chakram Split, HEXA Hex: Chakram Fury, HEXA Hex: Chakram Sweep, HEXA Death Blossom, HEXA Resonate and HEXA Deceiving Blade. The four HEXA Enhancement cores are Hex: Pandemonium Boost, Void Burst Boost, Arts: Astra Boost and Resonate: Ultimatum Boost; each is a flat final damage boost to its 5th job skill with a jump at level 10 (Hex: Pandemonium Boost reads +11% at Lv1, +19% at Lv9, +25% at Lv10). Shared HEXA skills present are Sol Janus with Dawn and Dusk, and Sol Hecate with Styx, Charon, Phlegethon and Pactum. All of these names and numbers are from MapleStory Wiki, last edited 2026-08-25.

innerAbility.notes: This is the only judgement field on Khali with genuine independent agreement, and it is the field least likely to have moved: the two sources are roughly two years and several patches apart and still line up. Date caution: the AyumiLove page is stamped 2024-09-20, before the project's 2025-01-01 preference bar, and the Grandis page is stamped GMS Ver. 269 against a v.271 target. Neither states an attack speed line for Khali, and no source found addresses whether one is wanted - see gearingNotes for the attack speed facts.

gearingNotes: Facts that change gear and inner ability reasoning for Khali specifically, all from MapleStory Wiki (last edited 2026-08-25) unless noted, and all stated as facts rather than recommendations because no guide was found that draws conclusions from them. MAGIC ATT MATTERS ON GEAR: Khali carries the Flora racial passive Magic Conversion, which converts 50% of the Magic ATT on her equipment into Attack Power, excluding the weapon, with set effects not applying and the conversion capped at 20% of the weapon's base Attack Power. A planner that treats Magic ATT as dead stat for a thief will misprice Khali's gear. CRITICAL RATE: her own kit supplies Critical Rate +35% from the 2nd job passive Impulse at max, and nothing else in the 1st-4th job kit adds critical rate, so she is nowhere near self-capping and the remainder must come from links, legion, hyper stats and gear. CRITICAL DAMAGE: Impulse gives +20% and the 4th job passive Chakram Expert +23%, with Chakram Expert also giving Attack Power +42 and Chakram Mastery 71% at max. IGNORE DEFENSE AND FINAL DAMAGE FROM PASSIVES: Intuition at max reads Final Damage +28%, Ignore Defense +20%, Attack Power +30; Redemption at max reads Final Damage +35%, Ignore Defense +22%, Boss Damage +30%. The two Ignore Defense figures are quoted separately and deliberately not summed, since ignore-defense sources stack multiplicatively. ATTACK SPEED: the only persistent source inside her own kit is Chakram Booster at Chakram Attack Speed +2; the 5th job skill Hex: Pandemonium raises attack speed by up to +3 while its realm of chaos is active, which is a temporary window rather than a standing buff. No source found states what attack speed cap Khali sits at once geared, so no conclusion is drawn about the attack speed inner ability line. COOLDOWN IS A RESOURCE: her pre-5th-job Arts skills reduce the cooldowns of Void Rush and Void Blitz, and her Hex skills are cooldown-gated, per Grandis Library's mechanics block - which is the visible reason both sourced inner ability sets open with Chance to Skip Cooldown. DARK SIGHT: Void Rush and Void Blitz put Khali into Dark Sight, and Grandis Library publishes a tested list of boss attacks avoidable in Dark Sight on her page, credited to the Night Walker Discord.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
defects: FABRICATED RELATIONSHIP - the SECONDARY tier. The file records 'SECONDARY tier - Node 4: Resonate, Deceiving Blade'. The Grandis Library page it cites contains only two node-tier arrays: "primary":[0,1,2,3] and "other":[4,5]. There is no secondary array and no node is rendered SECONDARY. Node index 3 IS Resonate + Deceiving Blade, so Grandis classes it PRIMARY. The PRIMARY/SECONDARY/OTHER legend the file quotes is generic boilerplate shared across class pages, not a Khali assignment. A planner shipping this would tell players to deprioritise a node their own cited source calls primary.

FABRICATED CONFLICT #1. The recorded conflict says Grandis classifies the Resonate + Deceiving Blade node SECONDARY 'on the stated grounds that those skills do not unlock a 6th Job HEXA Mastery'. Grandis never says this. The same page's sixth.masteryCore block explicitly contains a '4th Mastery Node' whose detail reads 'Requires Resonate / Deceiving Blade (3rd Job) enhanced with V Matrix at least Lv. 40 (before Matrix Points) to unlock', unlocking HEXA Resonate and HEXA Deceiving Blade. Grandis and MapleStory Wiki agree completely - 4 mastery nodes, node 4 = Resonate + Deceiving Blade. There is no disagreement to record, and the file's speculation that 'the Grandis rationale predates those cores' is explaining away a conflict that does not exist.

CONFLICT #2 IS A CATEGORY ERROR, not a real disagreement. It compares Grandis's boost-node groupings against mastermysty's trio recommendations as if they were the same object. They are not: the Grandis groupings are the game's own fixed core compositions, confirmed identically by MapleStory Wiki's independent V Enhancements list. Grandis's actual TRIO recommendation is a separate field (nodeInfo.recommended) the researcher never extracted - 'Primary Trio': Arts: Flurry/Crescentum + Void Rush + Hex: Chakram Sweep/Split/Fury; 'Secondary Trio': Resonate/Deceiving Blade + Void Blitz + Death Blossom. Against mastermysty (Trio #1 Flurry/Void Rush/Void Blitz, Trio #2 Chakram Sweep/Resonate/Death Blossom) the two sources largely AGREE - both pair Flurry with Void Rush, both pair Resonate with Death Blossom - and differ only by swapping Void Blitz and Chakram Sweep between the trios. The real conflict is one slot wide, not two whole trios.

FALSE NEGATIVE CLAIM. vMatrix.notes states 'Grandis Library's skill preview does not show Arts: Astra, so any tool validating node names should use the wiki list.' The Grandis page carries Arts: Astra with a full stat line (MP Cost: 500, Max Enemies Hit: 8, Damage: 1000%, Number of Attacks: 6, Ancient Chakram Summoned: 3) and also Arts: Astra Boost as an Upgraded Passive. The claim is wrong and the validation instruction it seeds is unfounded.
